               CITY MAYOR’S OFFICE
PERSONS WITH DISABILITY AFFAIRS OFFICE (PDAO)

                                                        1
Issuance of Persons with Disability (PWD) ID, Medicine and Purchase Booklet

Republic Act 9442 and provides PWD with all the benefits and privileges including special
discounts in medicines and basic necessities and prime commodities. To avail of the discounts,
however, the PWD or the authorized representative must present the PWD ID and purchase
booklet which are processed and issued by PDAO.

Office or Division:          Persons with Disability Affairs Office (PDAO)

Classification:              Simple

Type of Transaction: G2C – Government to Citizen

Who may avail:               Residents only

How to send feedback     FEEDBACK AND COMPLAINTS MECHANISM

                                                 Answer the Client’s Satisfaction Survey Form (CSSF) and
                                                 insert in folder or envelop.

How feedbacks are processed   Every 4:30pm, JO Staff compiles all forms and submit to
                              DAO II. Feedbacks requiring answers are forwarded to the
                              relevant Division/Section that will be required to answer
                              within three (3) days of the receipt of the feedback. The
                              answer of the office is then relayed to the client.

How to file a complaint       • Send text/email or call up
                                  PDAO-Legazpi City

                              E-mail address: pdaocmolegazpicity@gmail.com
                              Head of Office: 0923-726-5010 / 0917-777-9695

                              • Secure, fill-out properly and sign CSSF provided and
                                file the same

How complaints are processed  • Complaints by phone/online messages: action to be
                                  taken by DAO II or Admin Officer IV

                              • Acknowledge receipt and record/log the complaint

                              • Verify the existence and identity of the
                                  texter/caller/complainant

                              • Analyze complaint and take appropriate action

                              • Inform/notify the client of the action taken through
                                  text/email/letter

                              • If not within the level of authority, endorse/forward
                                  complaint to Head of Office for appropriate action

How complaints are processed  • Inform/notify the client of the action taken through
                                  text/email

                              If in the CSSF Folder:

                              • JO Staff opens the folder on a daily basis and evaluates
                                  each Customer Satisfaction Survey Form.

                              8
                                       • If a complaint is in the comments, JO Staff forwards the
                                           same to DAO II / AO IV.

                                       • Upon evaluation, the DAO II / AO IV / Complaints
                                           Officer shall start the investigation and forward the
                                           complaint to the relevant division/section for
                                           explanation.

                                       • The DAO II / AO IV will create a report and submit it to
                                           the HR for appropriate action.

                                       • The DAO II / AO IV will give the feedback to the client.
